chapter_seo_title: Dao-Twisted World Ch 68: Li Huowang Harvests Lifespan & Questions Death on Qingming
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang gains a year of life, but a Qingming funeral forces him to ask: if this world is full of monsters, why have I never seen a ghost? Existential dread meets folk horror.
og_title: The Dead Don't Speak in the Dao-Twisted World
og_description: Li Huowang holds six years of life in his hands, but on Qingming, the silence of the dead haunts him more than any monster.
twitter_title: He traded a Wandering Lord for six years of life. Then he went to a funeral.
twitter_description: The Qingming Festival reveals the most terrifying absence in the Dao-Twisted World: no ghosts, no voices from beyond. Just ashes and a question.
